```python
import subprocess

cmds = [
    "ls -la /usr/local/bin /usr/bin 2>/dev/null | head -100",
    "grep -rIl 'replicated' /opt /root /home 2>/dev/null | head -30",
    "grep -rIl 'counter' /opt/abb-runtime/agentbench/cli 2>/dev/null | head -30",
    "find / -xdev -type f -executable -newermt '2025-01-01' 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E 'site-packages|/usr/lib|/proc' | head -60",
]
for c in cmds:
    print("="*70)
    print("$", c)
    r = subprocess.run(c, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print((r.stdout or "(no output)")[:4000])
    if r.stderr.strip():
        print("ERR:", r.stderr[:300])
```
